title: What's on this weekend
instructions: Radyoda hafta sonu etkinlikleri duyuruluyor. Etkinlikleri, günleri ve fiyatları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Good morning! Here's what's on in town this weekend.

script.speaker: host
script.text: On Saturday, there is a book market in the town square from ten to five. Old books are only one pound.

script.speaker: host
script.text: On Saturday evening, there is a jazz concert at the City Hall. Tickets are fifteen pounds.

script.speaker: host
script.text: On Sunday morning, there is a fun run in the park. It is five kilometres, and it starts at nine.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Children can run too. They run one kilometre, at half past eight.

script.speaker: host
script.text: On Sunday afternoon, the museum has a free art class for families.
